# Copilot instructions

Before working in this repository, read and follow:
1. **[CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md)**: project memory (repo map, commands, conventions, where work is tracked). It applies to all AI agents, not only Claude.
2. **[.specify/memory/constitution.md](../.specify/memory/constitution.md)**: binding principles (privacy, official-source accuracy, no build/dependencies, human review).
3. For weekly opportunity research issues: **[opportunity-verify.md](prompts/opportunity-verify.md)** and **[opportunity-discover.md](prompts/opportunity-discover.md)**. Each job writes `data/opportunities/sources/research-<job>-<SCOPE>.json`.

Work items are GitHub issues labelled `roadmap`. Specs live in `specs/NNN-name/` (spec → plan → tasks). Resume from the first unchecked task in `tasks.md`, keep checkboxes updated, and link `Closes #N` in the PR.
